from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 80.0
thickness = 6.3
central_hole_diameter = 14.6
hole_diameter = 20.2
hole_circle_radius = 25.15
groove_outer_radius = 32.65
groove_depth = 0.7

import math

solid_body = Cylinder(outer_diameter / 2, thickness)
solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(central_hole_diameter / 2, thickness)

for i in range(3):
    angle = math.radians(90 + i * 120)
    px = hole_circle_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = hole_circle_radius * math.sin(angle)
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, thickness)

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, thickness / 2 - groove_depth / 2) * Cylinder(groove_outer_radius, groove_depth)

part = solid_body
part.name = "flanged_disc_with_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")
